subject: RE: RFP - annual partner conference, 45 delegates
body:
Hello Julie,

Answering by Friday, with a day to spare.

Our live rate calendar publishes 21 days out, so your October dates are not yet loaded into it. I checked the nearest comparable midweek two-night block, which is running comfortably below full house across those dates - a 45-delegate conference plus meeting space is comfortable rather than tight.

Our day delegate rate for a plenary plus three breakouts, with dinner both evenings, works out to EUR 335 per delegate per night - EUR 30,150 for 45 delegates over two nights, subject to final dates.

Name your two dates and I will place a provisional hold the same day.

Warm regards,
Hotel Aurora Sales & Events
